scope: One tiny pre-encoded lossless VP9/WebM presented by an actual HTML video in desktop and compact native captures. This is not broad codec, natural-video, colour-management or hardware validation.

extensionBuild.input: sorted dist filenames, NUL, bytes, NUL

limitations: Unvalidated candidate engine: no WCAG PASS or NON_CONFORMANT verdict. SDR sRGB is assumed; HDR and colour-management accuracy are not validated.
Reported area is a measured pixel ratio, not the WCAG visual-field threshold. Fine patterns, DOM attribution and red black-point chromaticity are not validated.

Candidate start/end times are relative to the first analyzed decoded frame, not the scenario start. Leading capture delay is reported separately; source and wall-clock timestamps are not interchangeable.
